Examples

slopball3d — co-op physics soccer, third dimension on

2 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓
On this page ↓
What 3D actually changedRun itAutomated tests

Use this Kit example to replicate 3D Godot physics bodies. The ball is a RigidBody3D that arcs, bounces and tumbles; players are CharacterBody3D capsules. play.Puppet3 lets the ball's entity owner simulate it and stream its pose and momentum, while other peers freeze their solver and display the received state.

What 3D actually changed#

The 3D version reuses Kit's session and replication APIs, with these physics and rotation choices:

  • The wire core changed nothing. Session, streams, deltas, commands, chat, lobby: all dimension-free. A kicker streams its pose as one pos: [3]f32 field.
  • Rotation uses a quaternion. The 2D puppet must snap its angle (a componentwise lerp sweeps the long way around the ±π wrap); the stream layer's .Quat kind nlerps hemisphere-safely, so rot: gd.Quaternion on play.Puppet3 interps correctly and watchers see the tumble turn smoothly.
  • Angular velocity crosses the seam. A 3D ball's tumble is its rolling contact — play.Puppet3 streams it and seeds it at the handoff alongside linear velocity.
  • The engine trap is identical. RigidBody3D ignores node transform writes exactly like its 2D sibling; every imposed pose goes through PhysicsServer3D.body_set_state.
  • The whole feel ledger transferred verbatim (see slopball's README): seat anticipation, sticky possession, intent gating, render-error smoothing, predicted possession (puppet3_claim), physics interpolation + cut resets. The arbitration runs on ground-plane (XZ) distances; kicks loft with a y impulse.

Run it#

From examples/slopball3d, build once with bash ../../build/build_scripts.sh ., then open two windows on one machine:

Shell
SLOP3_NAME=lefty  godot --path .    # Host
SLOP3_NAME=righty godot --path .    # Join

WASD moves on the pitch plane, Space kicks (lofted), first to SLOP3_GOALS (default 3) takes the match. Odd seats defend the left goal, even the right.

Automated tests#

  • run.sh — solo gate (SLOPBALL3D_SINGLE_OK): the striker bot runs the whole loop headless, exercising the 3D physics solver under --headless.
  • native_run.sh — 3-peer integration test (SLOPBALL3D_NATIVE_OK): host + striker + watcher. The seat transfers to the striker client, its local solver (gravity, tumble) scores, and the three screens agree on the ball within centimeters at the same session tick.
